about.title: About Sweksha Beauty
about.description: Sweksha Beauty is a friendly neighbourhood parlour in Main Market, Haveli Kharagpur, Munger, Bihar. Our aim is to give every woman a clean, comfortable and relaxed space where she can refresh herself and walk out with confidence. From simple threading to complete bridal makeovers, we believe in hygiene, quality products and personalised care.
values: Honest suggestions that suit your skin and hair
